definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: CardKB v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code
registers.newer_shared_driver: The current driver also probes 0xF1 and supports v2 report mode; v2 is not asserted for U035-B.

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.
